params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of records to return.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page. Omit for the first page.

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort by a supported field. Prefix with `-` for descending order.

items.docs: Return every Pipeline in the organization with its ordered stage definitions nested inline. Pipelines are the container for Deal stages — read this first to discover valid `pipeline_id` and `pipeline_stage_id` values for the Deal endpoints. Sort supports `created_at` or `-created_at`; pagination uses `limit` and `cursor`.

params.name: pipeline_id
params.description: Opaque Pipeline ID with the `pipeline_` prefix.

items.docs: Return a single Pipeline by its `pipe_` ID with all nested stage definitions in position order.
